_comment_top: Calibration provenance for the Pistachio metric pipeline. Records when the FG-2025 reference data was snapshotted, when the team-of-clones sim sweeps were run, and which OOTP version they came from. Read by calibration scripts to fail loudly if the inputs are stale. Update this whenever you re-run sim sweeps OR refresh the FG reference CSVs.
_comment_ootp_version: OOTP major version used for the team-of-clones sweeps. A version bump invalidates the multiplier tables in metrics_fielding.py and the PITCHING_COMPONENTS_ADJUST_MAP coefficients in config.py — both were fit on OOTP 27 sim behaviour.
_comment_sim_sweep_date: Last date the team-of-clones sweeps in `OOTP simulation/OOTP sims.xlsx` were re-run. Older than 6 months is a warning; older than 12 months means re-run before trusting the WAR coefficients. Default tolerance is encoded in calibration scripts; see CALIBRATION_STALENESS_MAX_DAYS in config.py.
_comment_fg_snapshot_year: FanGraphs season the per-position reference CSVs in calibration/fg_2025/ were sourced from. Used as the anchor for POSITIONAL_ADJUSTMENT_RUNS via posadj_shift_calibration.py. Re-snapshot at the start of each MLB season to keep the FG anchor representative of contemporary positional value.
_comment_fg_snapshot_date: When the FG CSVs were downloaded. Per-position ceiling data is volatile early in a season; mid-season snapshots are typical and adequate.
_comment_rpw: RUNS_PER_WIN_HITTING used by metrics_hitting.calc_war and the FG reference scripts. Should match FG's published RPW for the snapshot year; FG 2025 is 10.28. Different from FG's RPW => calibration drift.
_comment_drift_check: Run `python -X utf8 calibration/staleness_check.py` to verify these values are still in tolerance. Add this check to a pre-merge hook if doing serious calibration work.
